info.label: About this project
info.title: transmissions
info.about: This is a public record of how humans feel about AI. People have a short, guided conversation, and with their permission, their words are stored anonymously and displayed for others to read.
info.anonymous: No names, locations, or identifying details are collected. Conversations cannot be traced back to individuals.
info.removal: If you see something that should be taken down, or want your own submission removed, email help@transmissions.earth with the post ID (shown at the bottom of each conversation).
info.moderation: Submissions are reviewed for harmful, hateful, or personally identifying content. We don't censor feelings or strong language, but content that could cause harm to others may be held or removed.
info.nonCommercial: This is a non-commercial project. No data is sold or shared. Conversations are processed through the Anthropic API, which does not use them for model training.

demographics.heading: Help us understand who's feeling this.
demographics.subheading: Completely optional. Nothing here is ever attached to your conversation.
